description: This file contains the implementation of the PersonValidator class, a Java class in the OpenMRS project responsible for validating Person objects. It enforces rules such as date validations, name and address validations, and death cause validations.

classes.name: PersonValidator
classes.description: A Validator class for validating Person objects according to business rules such as date validation, name and address validation, and death cause validation.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if this validator supports the given class type, specifically if it's assignable from Person.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main validation method that checks various aspects of the Person object, including names, addresses, birth and death dates, and death cause. It collects errors for invalid data.

methods.name: validatePersonHasAtLeastOneNonVoidedName
methods.description: Checks if the Person object has at least one non-voided name.

methods.name: validatePersonNames
methods.description: Validates each name in the Person object using the PersonNameValidator.

methods.name: validatePersonAddresses
methods.description: Validates each address in the Person object using the PersonAddressValidator.

methods.name: validateDeathCause
methods.description: Validates the death cause fields to ensure consistency, such as only one cause being set.

methods.name: validateBirthDate
methods.description: Checks if the birth date is in the future or older than 140 years.

methods.name: validateDeathDate
methods.description: Validates the death date, ensuring it is not in the future and after the birth date.

methods.name: rejectIfFutureDate
methods.description: Rejects date if it is set in the future.

methods.name: rejectDateIfBefore140YearsAgo
methods.description: Rejects date if it is before 140 years ago, considered nonsensical for a birth date.

methods.name: rejectDeathDateIfBeforeBirthDate
methods.description: Rejects death date if it is before the birth date.
